artifacts.caption:
Seriously, keep that LinkedIn profile updated – it’s your first impression.

An AI internship is a launchpad for your career, and your LinkedIn profile needs to reflect that. I’ve learned a few things during my experience that could help you maximize yours. 

First, hands-on project engagement was absolutely key. Working on real-world challenges, even remotely – several different remote locations were used during the LinkedIn internship – made a huge difference. 

Second, networking was identified as a crucial element of a successful internship. Don’t be afraid to reach out to colleagues and ask questions. 

Third, maintaining an up-to-date LinkedIn profile was highlighted as a key strategy. Seriously, it’s where recruiters will find you. The experience of remote internships was ‘a blast’! 

What’s one thing you’re doing to level up your networking game? Share your tips below! 🚀

Share your biggest internship takeaway!
